definitions.hash: Keccak round_update or SHA256 round/feed-forward; attribution priority.
definitions.profile_active: Symbolic core.IDLE/core.FAILED exclusion matching core.cycles; FINISH included.
definitions.hash_template_nonhash: Accepted explicit HASH command through sampled command_done inclusive, excluding Hash.
definitions.recipe_nonhash: Accepted scalar request through consumed response inclusive, excluding Hash; subset of template clocks.
definitions.control_fetch: Sequencer FETCH opcode from current program_data, not stale token.
definitions.joint_histogram: Remaining clocks only, sampled before positive clock edge. State IDs diagnostic; categories use enum-based semantic predicates.

comparison_role: Controlled compiler-policy ablation on current production i hardware; not a new best i design.
